text: in the documentation i need you to make it extremely explicit that react = ui authoring. but all the actual tooling is going to be host owned
resolution: Documented the architecture boundary explicitly in cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/DESIGN_INTAKE.md and docs/game/GUIDING_LIGHT.md: React/TSX is UI authoring for chrome, panels, menus, inspectors, preview sockets, and mock state; actual tooling is host/native-owned for execution, validation, timing, persistence, diagnostics, file IO, compile/export, and other real editor operations. Added the required command/eventbus flow and the rule that any React-side tool behavior before host support must be labeled as a mock/preview shim/adapter with a named native owner.
